system_description.narrative_title: U.S.-Iran military escalation and widening regional spillover
system_description.narrative_summary: A rapid cycle of attack and retaliation between the United States and Iran — driven by a surprise Iranian missile/ballistic strike and U.S. counter‑strikes — is the dominant dynamic, producing spillovers across the Middle East and into global energy and transport chokepoints. Treated as an open system, it consists of military actions (strikes, missile launches, drone attacks), political‑diplomatic signals (sanctions, briefings, pledges), and economic effects (energy/insurance disruptions, market responses) that flow in and out of the system boundary. Key feedbacks include escalation–retaliation loops, proxy activation and cross‑theatre contagion (Gaza, Egypt/Suez, Black Sea/Ukraine), shifts in alliance behaviour and sanctions, and market/insurance reactions that in turn alter political and military choices.
system_description.scope: Direct and proximate interactions among the U.S., Iran (including IRGC and proxy networks), regional theatres (Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Gaza, Egypt), and immediate consequences for energy infrastructure, maritime chokepoints, and global financial/insurance responses.
system_description.super_system: The international security and strategic-economic order (great power competition, global trade/energy networks, international law and sanctions regime).
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy and maritime chokepoints (Suez, Red Sea, Black Sea; oil & gas export infrastructure)
Russia–Ukraine conflict and Black Sea security
International sanctions, insurance and global financial markets

variables.name: Military engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the aggregated rate, scale and tempo of kinetic military actions (strikes, launches, sorties) across the system.

variables.name: Escalation pressure
variables.description: Measures the systemic tension and propensity for reciprocal intensification of hostile actions between actors.

variables.name: Proxy activation level
variables.description: Measures the degree of mobilization, operational tempo and geographic spread of proxy and surrogate forces.

variables.name: Cross‑theatre contagion rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which conflict dynamics, tactics or attacks spread from one theatre or domain to another.

variables.name: Alliance cohesion strength
variables.description: Measures the degree of coordinated political and operational alignment among cooperating actors and coalitions.

variables.name: Sanctions and economic restriction intensity
variables.description: Measures the breadth, severity and enforcement pressure of economic measures and trade restrictions affecting actors.

variables.name: Energy infrastructure disruption
variables.description: Measures the extent and persistence of damage, outages or interdiction affecting energy production and transport infrastructure.

variables.name: Maritime chokepoint security
variables.description: Measures the security, transit reliability and threat level across critical maritime and canal routes.

variables.name: Insurance and risk premia level
variables.description: Measures prevailing insurance costs, risk surcharges and underwriting constraints for shipping, energy and trade flows.

variables.name: Market volatility influence
variables.description: Measures the intensity and speed of price and financial-market fluctuations that feed back into policy and operational choices.

variables.name: Intelligence early‑warning capacity
variables.description: Measures the capability to detect, attribute and provide timely warning of imminent hostile actions or surprises.

variables.name: Command-and-control resilience
variables.description: Measures the robustness and redundancy of command, communications and logistics systems under stress or attack.

variables.name: Deterrence credibility
variables.description: Measures the perceived credibility and expected effectiveness of punitive or coercive threats in preventing hostile acts.

variables.name: Civilian humanitarian strain
variables.description: Measures civilian displacement, casualty levels and unmet humanitarian needs that affect political and operational constraints.

variables.name: Cyber and information operations intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency, scale and impact of cyber attacks, disinformation and information‑domain operations in the system.

variables.name: Arms and munition stock levels
variables.description: Measures availability, depletion and replenishment rates of key weapons, missile and munitions stocks relevant to operations.

catalysts.title: U.S. two‑week escalation of strikes in Iran
catalysts.description: U.S. commander’s two‑week plan and presidential approval signal an intensified strike campaign in Iran over the coming fortnight.
catalysts.rationale: “Two‑Week Plan to Escalate Strikes” and Trump approval/headlines indicate an imminent intensified strike campaign.

catalysts.title: US/Israeli bombardment of Iran energy targets
catalysts.description: Reports that the U.S. and Israel plan strikes on Iran energy‑related targets could lead to targeted attacks on Iranian energy infrastructure imminently.
catalysts.rationale: CBS and other reports: US, Israel planning to bombard energy‑related targets in Iran.

catalysts.title: Chinese shoulder‑launched missiles delivered to Iran
catalysts.description: Sourced reports that China will supply shoulder‑launched missile systems to Iran within weeks, enhancing Iranian and proxy capabilities.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: “Iran to get Chinese shoulder‑launched missile systems in weeks,” increasing proxy and Iranian capabilities.

catalysts.title: Continued drone attacks on ships and Suez area
catalysts.description: A cluster of drone strikes on ships, tankers and port facilities (Damietta, Suez area) indicates an ongoing campaign threatening shipping routes.
catalysts.rationale: Multiple headlines: drone hits at Damietta, Suez and storage tanker fires indicate widening attacks on shipping/energy.

catalysts.title: Expanded U.S. sanctions targeting insurers, tankers and networks
catalysts.description: US announced new sanctions on insurers, tankers and support networks (Mahan Air); further rounds and enforcement actions likely in near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: “US issues new Iran‑related sanctions targeting insurers, more tankers” and Mahan Air network sanctions.

catalysts.title: Contest over south Lebanon 'pilot zones' expands
catalysts.description: Problems in the first test of US‑backed pilot zones in south Lebanon make further clashes or expanded operations likely, risking Hezbollah involvement.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: first test of US‑backed 'pilot zones' in south Lebanon exposes difficulties, implying more clashes.

catalysts.title: Potential Gaza ceasefire agreement or breakdown
catalysts.description: Rare progress in Gaza ceasefire talks could produce a formal truce or collapse; either outcome would reshape regional operational tempo.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: “Gaza ceasefire talks see rare progress,” creating a plausible ceasefire or fragile breakdown.

catalysts.title: U.S. tightening operational security for regional troops
catalysts.description: Reports U.S. military may require some Mideast troops to surrender cell phones, an operational security tightening likely to be implemented soon.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: US military may require some troops in Mideast to surrender cell phones, increasing operational security.
